summary: This bill requires military service academies to accept the Classic Learning Test (CLT) scores for admission and mandates that federally-run secondary schools, including those operated by the Department of Defense Education Activity and the Bureau of Indian Education, administer the CLT to eleventh-grade students.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates that military service academies accept the Classic Learning Test (CLT) for admissions and requires Department of Defense Education Activity (DODEA) schools to administer the CLT. While it affects military institutions, it does not directly address military spending levels, but rather educational standards within existing military-related structures.
